name: decoder_native_topology_tail
hypothesis: C1 fallback cases show higher reliable-near native order disagreement; replacing absolute center imitation with worst-pair decoder-native topology hinge may reduce unchanged slim3 fallbacks. Association is not causal proof.
model: Same student.py v2 241547-parameter small F and frozen E74; no architecture/decoder change
initialization: Warm-start all C1 own-Loss best weights, including all output heads; frozen E74 unchanged; fresh AdamW and RNG/seed0. New Loss/run; no old optimizer/scheduler inherited.
data: v5 frozen first16000 train and same dev_monitor500; train_monitor500 reuse train labels; source has inherited32k exposure

teacher.method: Read-only reuse of completed16500 public-solver teacher; no regeneration or additional labels
teacher.inputs: public specs/connectivity/current frozen NN draft only, no free reference geometry or official score denominators
teacher.labels: center/log-aspect of final public-solver geometry; stored only as supervision, never network input
teacher.usable: strict public hard-legal, finite, not row_control fallback; all members retained, fallback labels carry zero imitation weight
teacher.panel: train16000+dev_monitor500 only; no full dev2000 or test teacher generation

loss.topology_tail: Decode target and prediction to actual nominal-area/locked rectangles. For valid distinct teacher-near pairs with at least one free center: native score per axis=abs(center_delta)/half_extent_sum-1; teacher chosen axis=argmax(score), sign=teacher delta sign. Retain teacher axis advantage>=.05. Required advantage=min(teacher advantage,.1). Predicted signed delta/extent along chosen teacher axis minus abs delta/extent along other axis; each raw normalized delta clamped[-8,8]. Squared positive hinge(required-predicted advantage), max over reliable near pairs per case, zero if none. Using prediction extents connects shape and topology.
loss.shape: Same C1 squared log-aspect on free shapes
loss.relative: Same C1 SmoothL1 beta.1 teacher-near relative center difference/public mean sqrt(area), near distance<=.25 mean local scale, valid distinct pairs with a free center
loss.monitoring: Identical per-case total for backward/train500/dev500/best/LR/early-stop; all frozen members in arithmetic mean
loss.scope: No free reference labels/denominators, no dev coefficient sweep. C1 and unchanged slim3 controls reused.

engine: source cached frozen L drafts; CUDA graph for F+same Loss+backward+clip, guarded AdamW outside; graph/real update/resume checked on five train members before formal start
terminal: unique own-Loss best: one fixed dev500 true batch1 GPU+same slim3 full request evaluation and same100 four-stage gallery; full dev2000 raw diagnostics if budget permits; no Q checkpoint reselection
caveats: Topology error association is not causal proof; max pair hinge can focus on outliers and degrade compactness; same complete-Q terminal decides.
Teacher labels lack actual tolerance-area WH; nominal reconstructed target not necessarily legal, preserved without filtering.
Teacher aspect targets exceed decode range for9 train cases; target topology uses actual clipped decode; shape label errors retained.
C2 differs in warm-start and objective; cannot attribute any gain solely to a single coefficient. No new stronger CPU repair.
Native mode0 topology is learned, not the complete alternating-boundary/group solver feasibility condition.
training_start_gate: Five original train actual update/graph/resume/finite/frozen-L checks and source/teacher identities pass before formal start
